measurement.wall_ms: time.perf_counter around Popen..wait4 of the subject process
measurement.cpu_ms: ru_utime + ru_stime from wait4 (user + system, subject process and its waited children)
measurement.peak_rss_bytes: ru_maxrss from wait4 (the subject process itself; same source as /usr/bin/time -l)
measurement.ttfr_ms: first REQ logged by fixture-server minus the subject's spawn time (same wall clock)
